name: Desert
descriptions: Endless dunes of pale sand roll toward the horizon. Heat shimmers above the ground, blurring the distance.
Cracked, hard-baked earth stretches flat in every direction. Nothing grows here but a few wiry thornbushes.
The wind has carved the sand into sharp ridges that crumble beneath your feet.
A bleached skeleton, half-buried in sand, marks where some creature met its end.
Wind-scoured rock pillars rise from the sand, their bases worn thin by countless storms.
The sand here is coarse and reddish, crunching underfoot. A lizard watches you from a sunlit stone.
A dry gully cuts through the dunes, its bed littered with smooth stones from some long-gone river.

lines: Hot wind hisses across the sand.
The sun beats down without mercy.
